name: Code assignment from clinical notes
auto_rationale: AI can assist in drafting codes based on clinical notes, but human expertise is needed for final validation.

name: Claim building
auto_rationale: The process of building a claim can be fully automated using AI systems that integrate with billing software.

name: Query generation for missing fields
auto_rationale: AI can generate queries for missing information, but human intervention is needed to send them.

name: Claim submission
auto_rationale: Claim submission can be fully automated through electronic systems.

name: Denial analysis and appeal letter writing
auto_rationale: AI can assist in drafting appeal letters based on denial reasons, but human judgment is required for context.

name: Payment posting to patient ledger
auto_rationale: This task requires manual entry and cannot be automated due to the need for physical handling.

name: Intake and logging of counterparty's draft
auto_rationale: This task involves data entry which can be fully automated by AI systems.

name: Clause comparison against standard playbook
auto_rationale: AI can assist in drafting and flagging deviations, but human judgment is needed for final decisions.

name: Drafting proposed redlines for non-standard clauses
auto_rationale: AI can generate drafts, but a human must review and finalize the redlines.

name: Review of high-risk clauses
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment and expertise that cannot be automated.

name: Emailing negotiated changes to counterparty
auto_rationale: AI can assist in drafting emails, but human oversight is necessary for context and final approval.

name: Filing final executed copy in document repository
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves document management.

name: Tracking key dates like renewal and expiry
auto_rationale: This task requires ongoing human attention and cannot be fully automated.

name: Pull production volumes and material costs
auto_rationale: AI can assist in data extraction but human oversight is needed for context and accuracy.

name: Reconcile production volumes and material costs
auto_rationale: AI can help identify discrepancies, but human judgment is required to investigate variances.

name: Allocate overhead
auto_rationale: Overhead allocation by a fixed rule can be fully automated.

name: Prepare cost-of-goods journal entry
auto_rationale: AI can draft the journal entry, but a human must review for accuracy and compliance.

name: Review and approve journal entry
auto_rationale: This process requires human judgment and approval.

name: Generate closing report
auto_rationale: AI can assist in generating reports from templates, but human input is needed for finalization.

name: Distribute closing report
auto_rationale: The distribution of reports via email can be fully automated.
